title: NO CHANGE OF GUARD CEREMONY THIS SATURDAY
body_text:
The Change of Guard Ceremony at the Forecourt of Rashtrapati Bhavan will not take place this Saturday (August 22, 2026) due to the full rehearsal for the ceremonial welcome of the Prime Minister of Bangladesh.
***
MJPS/SS/PRK

enrichment.summary: The President's Secretariat announced that the weekly Change of Guard Ceremony at the Rashtrapati Bhavan forecourt will not be held on Saturday, 22 August 2026. The cancellation is due to a full rehearsal being conducted for the ceremonial welcome of the visiting Prime Minister of Bangladesh.
enrichment.context: The Change of Guard Ceremony is a weekly public event held at Rashtrapati Bhavan showcasing the President's Bodyguard and military bands, and is a popular tourist attraction. Such ceremonies are occasionally suspended to accommodate state ceremonial functions, including formal welcomes for visiting heads of state or government, which involve guard-of-honour rehearsals at the same venue. This notice is purely administrative and does not indicate any policy or diplomatic development beyond a scheduled bilateral visit by Bangladesh's Prime Minister.
